pages.text: When killing a Patrol Captain, you'll always get cursed with Bad Omen, which can be useful at times, but annoying and detrimental as well. After some research, you've devise a charm that absorbs the dying curse of the captain, sparing you the effect, even if the charm has reached level 5 its maximum level.

Not only that, if you currently have the Bad Omen on you, right-clicking with the charm, or pressing the Activate Curio key if equipped, will absorb it. Should you wish to be afflicted with Bad Omen within the charm, simply right-click with it, or press the Activate Curio key if equipped, if you don't currently have the effect on.
